Container.Name: WARHOST
Container.Overview:
WARHOST runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server on Unraid, one server per container. Enter the login and dedicated key Eugen sends you, your public IP, and a game port. The first start opens a base-game Hesse 2v2 lobby named WARHOST - Default Server Name, with no workshop mods. Change the name, map, and mods in the WebUI.
Request a login and key from eugsupport@eugensystems.com. One pair runs five servers. Forward each game port to this Unraid server as TCP and UDP. The lobby page uses WebUI Port, 11400 when Game Port is 10400. Each added container needs the next WebUI Port. Do not forward it. The Docker button follows the Advanced View WebUI box and stays on 11400 until that box is changed.

Config.Name: Settings Folder
Config.Description: Ini files for this container only. The next container uses this path with its own game port, for example /mnt/user/appdata/warno/10401/settings.

Config.Name: Eugen Login
Config.Description: Login from Eugen's reply, exactly as written. Not your Steam name; this login and the key are a matching pair good for five containers.

Config.Name: Eugen Dedicated Key
Config.Description: Key from the same reply. Paste the whole key. The log shows only the last 4 characters.

Config.Name: Public WAN IP
Config.Description: Public address players connect to. Not a hostname, and not this Unraid server's LAN address.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: true serves the lobby page on WebUI Port. Set the server name, map, and mods there. false leaves the Docker button with nothing listening.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: This port must be free on the Unraid host. Forward it as TCP and UDP. The next container uses this number plus 1. Set WebUI Port to this number plus 1000. Players join by the server name in the WebUI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Lobby page for this container. First server: 11400. The next uses this number plus 1. Do not forward it. The Docker button ignores this field. In Advanced View, change 11400 in the WebUI box to this number.

Config.Name: Write Config From Form
Config.Description: true rewrites login.ini each start, fills in missing lobby files, and refreshes a bare Workshop id to id/Version. false leaves the file contents in place and sets login.ini to mode 600.
